lessons.correction: Continue developing economy and technology, but strengthen your ground army and maintain a defensive posture while scouting for pressure.
lessons.mistake: Continuing to expand and tech aggressively without ensuring defensive capability, leaving yourself vulnerable to early pressure like Reaper harassment.
lessons.recheck: Recheck if opponent shows signs of a heavy push or tech switch; adjust defensive and tech priorities accordingly.
lessons.title: Avoid overextending economy without defense
lessons.when: Early-midgame, around 300 seconds, with heavy economy and production, opponent ground posture with possible Reaper harassment.
lessons.why: Your heavy investment will pay off midgame, but you need to survive early pressure. A solid ground core with Zealots and Stalkers provides flexibility.

lessons.correction: Continue developing economy and technology, while scouting to determine opponent's intentions. Build a solid foundation for midgame.
lessons.mistake: Making assumptions about the enemy's build without scouting, potentially neglecting defense while teching.
lessons.recheck: Recheck when you have more information about opponent's composition or if you scout an aggressive move.
lessons.title: Avoid assuming enemy build without scouting
lessons.when: Early game, around 180 seconds, with heavy economy and tech, opponent posture unknown.
lessons.why: Early game is about setting up economy and tech; scouting allows adaptation to opponent's strategy.

lessons.correction: Continue to strengthen ground army with tech units like Immortals and Colossi, while maintaining economy and expansion lead.
lessons.mistake: Neglecting upgrades and being caught out of position, as opponent may have high attack/defense upgrades and attempt a timing attack.
lessons.recheck: Recheck if opponent shows signs of a large push or tech switch; adjust composition accordingly.
lessons.title: Avoid neglecting upgrades and positioning
lessons.when: Late-midgame, around 600 seconds, opponent has heavy ground army with Siege Tanks and Medivacs, you have strong economy but need to solidify army.
lessons.why: Opponent's army is strong; Immortals counter tanks, Colossi handle bio, and upgrades are crucial.
